description: An attendance record exists only as evidence of a member attending a particular event; without the event the record has no meaning.
A member is linked to attendance records, but the link is weak in the sense that most members have no attendance rows recorded at all.
Budget line items are allocated to a club event, and each line item is meaningless without its event.
Individual expenses are the component parts of a budget line item's spending; every expense belongs to exactly one line item.
An expense is attributed to the member who incurred it, but only a small number of members appear as the member of record on expenses.

connection_condition: income.link_to_member corresponds to member.member_id, which is empty for organisational receipts
description: Income from dues is attributed to the paying member, whereas fundraising, sponsorship and school appropriation are not attributed to any member.
A member declares one academic major, which supplies the member's department and college; the link is optional.

connection_condition: member.zip holds the member's residential ZIP code
description: A member has exactly one residential ZIP code recorded directly on the member record.

connection_condition: member.zip and zip_code.zip_code share the same value domain and match for all 33 members
description: The member ZIP code and the ZIP code reference key express the same postal geography, both stored as integers and therefore both losing leading zeros.

connection_condition: zip_code.short_state is an attribute of the ZIP code referenced by the member
description: A member's state is derived from the member's ZIP code through the ZIP code reference table; no state column exists on the member record.

connection_condition: major.college names the college that hosts the major
description: A college is composed of its majors and departments; each major belongs to exactly one college.

connection_condition: budget.spent equals the sum of expense.cost over expenses charged to that budget line item
description: The spent amount of a budget line item is the accumulated cost of the expenses linked to it, and the two agree exactly wherever expenses exist.

connection_condition: budget.remaining equals budget.amount minus budget.spent on the same row
description: The remaining balance is computed from the allocated amount and the spent amount and is not floored at zero.

connection_condition: budget.spent divided by budget.amount on the same row
description: The utilisation rate is computed from the spent amount and the allocated amount; no utilisation column is stored.

connection_condition: counting distinct attendance rows per event or per member
description: The attendance count is produced by counting attendance records, since the table stores no numeric attendance field.

connection_condition: counting member records, optionally restricted by position or by declared major
description: The member count is produced by counting member records; no stored aggregate exists.

connection_condition: summing income.amount over rows whose source is Dues
description: Dues income is the accumulated amount of the dues receipts, each of which is a uniform per-member payment.

connection_condition: budget.event_status equals event.status for all 52 budget rows
description: The event status recorded on a budget line item and the status on the linked event express the same lifecycle state, so either column may ground the concept.
